multiSelect.refusal.clip: Clips and cuts are selected one at a time
multiSelect.refusal.click: Recorded clicks are ignored one at a time, or with {command}
multiSelect.refusal.caption: Captions are edited one at a time, or all at once in the Captions tab
multiSelect.refusal.layout: Camera layouts are changed one at a time; the director's tools redo many at once
multiSelect.why.zoom: a zoom is in the way
multiSelect.why.freezeClip: a freeze frame stays in its clip (drag it alone to move it past a cut)
multiSelect.why.freezeTaken: a freeze frame is already on that frame
multiSelect.freezeInCut: A selected freeze frame is in a cut, so the selection can't move. Ctrl+click it to leave it out
multiSelect.full: The selection already fills the recording
multiSelect.selectOnlyAgain: Selected the only {what} · {keys} again selects every item
multiSelect.selectAllAgain: Selected all {what} · {keys} again selects every item
multiSelect.shapesTrack: {count, plural, other {{n} items on the shapes track}}
multiSelect.copyLookFirst: Copy a look first: select one item and press {keys}
multiSelect.copyLookFirstButton: Copy a look first: select one item and press its Copy look button
multiSelect.nothingCopied: Nothing copied yet: select items and press {keys}
multiSelect.nothingCopiedPalette: Nothing copied yet: select items and run "{command}" from the command palette
notice.noRoomForZoom: There is no room for a new zoom here.
preview.groupOutline: Selected · click to edit it alone, Ctrl+click to leave it out
preview.groupHint: {count, plural, =1 {{n} selected item} other {{n} selected items}} on screen · Ctrl+click to add or remove
preview.focusHint: Click or drag to set where this zoom looks ·
preview.regionBox: Drag to move · corners resize (Shift: any shape)
preview.regionHint: Drag to draw the area to zoom into (Shift: any shape) ·
preview.followsResize: Follows the cursor: drag a corner to resize
preview.shapeBox: Drag to move · handles resize (Shift: keep the shape)
preview.cursorOff: the cursor is off the recording here
preview.dragToPlaceOrDraw: drag to place it, or drag elsewhere to draw it again
